Received Estimates is the other direction — prices your subs and your suppliers have quoted you.
Record what each came back with against the project and the scope, and you are comparing real numbers side by side instead of digging through email.
Tick two or more and Compare Selected puts them next to each other.
Mark the one you are going with as the winner, and it becomes a job — the amount you agreed carries straight over into what you owe them.
